badghost.configuration.Visuals.tooltip: Fake blocks only your own game knows about. The server keeps its own idea of the world, so you can stand on one and still fall through.
badghost.configuration.Template.tooltip: Whether the ghost key places a single block or lays out a whole shape.
badghost.configuration.Interface.tooltip: What the mod draws over your view.
badghost.configuration.Automation.toolti: Removing bedrock with the piston trick, one target at a time or several.
badghost.configuration.Preview.tooltip: Showing what the miner is about to build, before it builds it.
badghost.configuration.AutoScan.tooltip: Queueing nearby bedrock without being asked each time.
badghost.configuration.ESP.tooltip: Drawing an outline around the bedrock waiting to be mined.
badghost.configuration.ghostBlock.toolti: Which block the ghost key puts down. A name the game does not know is ignored, and the key tells you so instead of doing nothing.
badghost.configuration.frozenSlippery.to: Ghost blocks feel as slippery as ice. Only you feel it: the server still moves you by the real block below.
badghost.configuration.bouncy.tooltip: Landing on a ghost block bounces you, the way a slime block would. Only you bounce; the server sees an ordinary landing.
Nausea stops swirling your view, and blindness and darkness stop closing the fog in around you. Only the picture changes: the effects keep their full length and everything else they do to you still happens.
badghost.configuration.modelOffset.toolt: Draws player models this many blocks higher or lower. Affects everyone you can see, and moves only the picture — a player drawn higher is still standing where they were. Zero draws everyone normally.
badghost.configuration.cameraDistance.to: How far back the third-person camera sits, in blocks. The game uses 4. Larger pulls the view further out, and it still stops short of walls rather than pushing through them.
badghost.configuration.ghostLimit.toolti: How many ghost blocks may exist at the same time, so holding the key cannot fill your world without end. Reaching the limit stops placement and says so.
badghost.configuration.templateShape.too: What one press lays out. A single block paints one cell at a time while you hold the key; every other shape goes down whole on each press, and one undo takes the whole thing back.
badghost.configuration.templateSize.tool: How large a shape is, in blocks. A single block ignores this. Cells already occupied are stepped over and counted, so a shape that comes out smaller tells you why.
badghost.configuration.hudEnabled.toolti: Shows the panel in the top-left corner while the miner is armed. Turn it off for a clean screen; the miner keeps working either way, and the commands still answer. There is a key for this as well.
badghost.configuration.automationEnabled: Whether the miner is already armed when you enter a world. Off means you arm it yourself with the key, which is the safer default.
badghost.configuration.planMode.tooltip: Vertical only uses above and below, and needs nothing about your aim faked because it all happens in one tick. All directions also considers the four sides, reaching blocks the vertical approach cannot, at the cost of holding a false aim for a tick.
badghost.configuration.supportBlock.tool: What to put under the torch when there is nothing for it to stand on. Any solid block works; slime is easy to break back out.
badghost.configuration.limitMax.tooltip: How many bedrock blocks to work on at the same time. More is faster and spends pistons faster; one is the easiest to watch.
badghost.configuration.maxRetries.toolti: How many attempts a block gets before the miner gives up on it and says why.
badghost.configuration.waitTicks.tooltip: How long to wait for the piston to reach the state the trick needs, in ticks — twenty make a second. Raise it on a slow connection, where answers take longer to come back.
badghost.configuration.rotateSettleTicks: How long to hold a sideways aim before acting on it, in ticks. Used only when working from the sides, to give the server a tick to notice the turn.
badghost.configuration.skipInstaMineChec: Starts the trick even when your pickaxe cannot break a piston instantly. It will usually fail, because that instant break is the whole trick. For working out what is going wrong, not for mining.
badghost.configuration.previewEnabled.to: Outlines what the miner would build around the block you are looking at, or the cell in the way when it cannot be mined, with the reason named. Looking places nothing.
badghost.configuration.autoScanEnabled.t: Finds bedrock around you and queues it unasked. Off by default on purpose: on a bedrock floor or the nether roof there is always more, and this will spend every piston you own.
badghost.configuration.autoScanRadius.to: How far around you to search, in blocks.
How long between one search and the next, in ticks — twenty make a second.
badghost.configuration.espEnabled.toolti: Draws an outline around queued blocks, visible through walls, so you can see what the miner is going to reach.
badghost.configuration.espColor.tooltip: Six hex digits, red-green-blue. FFAA00 is amber. Something unreadable falls back to amber and says so.
badghost.configuration.espAlpha.tooltip: How solid the outline looks: 0 is invisible, 1 is fully solid.
